title: CyberSoft Digital Banking Customer Churn & Credit Telemetry
description: Retail digital banking dataset designed for exploratory data analysis (EDA), predictive churn modeling, and feature engineering. Includes customer financial health metrics, card activity, credit score tiers, and a binary churn indicator.

pii.handling_instructions: This dataset contains 100% synthetically simulated financial telemetry. No real bank accounts or customer identities exist.

upstream_sources: Statistical distribution fitted on European Credit Card & Kaggle Banking benchmarks
transformation_pipeline: Fit Gaussian Copula on financial behavioral distributions
Inject realistic Vietnamese banking tenure and balance ratios

sample_business_questions: Which credit score and balance tier exhibits the highest propensity to close accounts?
Does holding multiple banking products reduce the probability of customer attrition?
What is the estimated revenue loss if customers in the top churn decile are not engaged?
recommended_exercises: Lab 05: Build correlation matrix and hypothesis tests on churn drivers.
Lab 06: Train a baseline churn classifier and evaluate confusion matrix.
Capstone: End-to-end customer churn early warning dashboard.

tables.description: Denormalized customer financial features and 90-day forward churn label.

columns.name: account_id
columns.description: Synthetic masked bank customer account UUID

columns.name: tenure_months
columns.description: Months customer has held an active account

columns.name: account_balance_vnd
columns.description: Average quarterly savings balance in VND

columns.name: num_of_products
columns.description: Count of banking products utilized (Savings, Credit Card, Loan, Investment)

columns.name: is_active_member
columns.description: Active digital banking user in last 30 days (1=True, 0=False)

columns.name: exited_churn
columns.description: Target label: 1 if customer churned within 90 days, 0 otherwise

author: CyberSoft AI & Data Science Guild
